title: Your Brain Decides Before You Know It
description:
Neuroscientists can detect a decision forming seconds before you are aware of having made one. Your conscious self is often the last to know.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: Neuroscientists can detect a decision forming seconds before you are aware of having made one. Your conscious self is often the last to know.
That does not mean free will is fake. It means the work starts earlier than your awareness does.
It also explains moments of doubt. The choice is already running when your mind catches up and questions it.
Under fatigue the automatic systems take over, which is why late night decisions tend to repeat old patterns instead of breaking them.
The practical fix is to make big decisions in the morning, when the deliberate system still has fuel.
You are not slower than your brain. You are simply notified after the fact.
